verdict.rationale: Graphite documents AI reviews that flag issues and suggest fixes on every PR (graphite-docs-4). It also says you can apply suggested fixes in one click from the review page (graphite-docs-7, graphite-docs-50), and agent changes are committed directly to the PR branch (graphite-docs-52). That covers the core of committable, one-click suggestions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the review comments themselves carry inline suggested diffs, any coverage of human-reviewer suggestion blocks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the one-click apply flow.
